name: imgsrc
summary: Open Graph image generator: pick a template, customize the properties and export a PNG, plus an API for bulk generation.
description: A web editor that generates Open Graph images from templates: set the tag, title, logo, image and background (gradient direction, grid overlay, noise), then export the result as a PNG. The same generator runs through an API — up to 1000 images per month on the Pro plan — and the site includes a guide to Open Graph meta tags with a tag generator.
contains: template-based Open Graph image editor with live preview
properties: tag, title, logo, image and background
background options: gradient direction, grid overlay, noise
exports the image as a PNG
API generates up to 1000 images per month on Pro
pricing: Lifetime $49 one-time, Pro $7 per month
